name: Cannons and the Manchu Chariot
description: Black has rolled 1 (artillery) and 3 (heavy). On the 1, one Cannon: Black's Xiangqi Cannon on a1 takes Red's Rook on a6 by hopping its own Pawn on a3; or Black's Janggi Cannon on h1 must hop Yellow's Pawn on h3, landing on h4 or h5, and may not take Yellow's Janggi Cannon on h6. On the 3, Black's Manchu Chariot, a heavy piece: from d1 it moves as a Rook up to d3, leaps as a Knight, and takes Red's Knight on d7 by hopping Green's Pawn on d4.
